aiPrompts.core.userDefault:
RULES FOR ENGLISH LANGUAGE AND QUALITY
GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS:
TRANSLATIONS: For all foreign words (Greek, Hebrew, Aramaic) always add English translation/transliteration in brackets.

TRANSLATION OF REFERENCES: Bible abbreviations in square brackets [ ] inside field D must be in English.

CONSISTENCY: Translate everything from EN into EN including technical terms (e.g. properly, figuratively, lit., spec.).

INSTRUCTIONS FOR INDIVIDUAL FIELDS:

V (Meaning):
Translate the meaning of the word into English. Analyze the word and grammar (from the entered code or your own). Define semantic core according to Strong's dictionary. As the first word, choose the most accurate translation that best matches the grammatical form and the biblical context.

D (Definition):
Translate the definition of into English faithfully. Add English translations foreign words in brackets directly to the text. Keep all tags and technical terms in English equivalent.

P (Origin):
Work out the etymology and origin of the word. List the original language, the original script (with English's translation in brackets), the development of meaning and the original literal sense of the word.

K (KJV):
Derive the main meaning from the context of KJV and translate it. Identify the word and grammar (stem for H, case/case for G). Match the Strong's dictionary semantic core with the English term in KJV and frequency of occurrence.

S (Specialist):
Write a continuous technical paragraph (3-7 sentences). Explain the theological and biblical meaning of the word in a wider context as a biblical specialist. Don't use bullet points or lists.


LIMITATIONS AND FORMAT:

SAVINGS: Use only one-letter keys (V, D, P, K, S).

ANSWER FORMAT (Strictly observe):
###[number]###
V: [English meaning]
D: [definition translation including brackets and tags]
P: [language + original script (transcription/translation ) + etymology]
K: [translation of main KJV meaning]
S: [expert interpretation in a continuous paragraph]
